description.en: Twelve families cross the pass and settle by the river.
description.de: Zwölf Familien überqueren den Pass und siedeln am Fluss.

article.en:
The valley was empty but for deer and larks.

The founders chose the bend of the river for its shelter from the wind, and within a season had raised the first houses.
